veranderings.blok: Baie nader aan ons as die Son
veranderings.voor: en ook net soveel kere verder weg
veranderings.na: maar ook net soveel kere verder weg
veranderings.rede: The two halves pull against each other (bigger, yet further away), so 'maar' carries the reasoning more clearly than 'en'; no comma, as the second half has no subject of its own.
